svg.title: Тяга верхнего блока одной рукой — положение 2
svg.desc: Original ImageGen hollow contour, vector traced. One-arm seated high cable lat pulldown, three-quarter view facing the tall high pulley. The same person sits upright on a lat-pulldown seat with thigh restraint pads. ONE short single D-shaped handle is attached to one continuous cable from the HIGH overhead pulley. Only the right hand grasps the handle, free left hand remains on left thigh in both phases. Left figure working arm reaches high above shoulder; right figure pulls that handle down beside the shoulder with elbow close to side, upper arm low. Cable visibly connects handle to overhead pulley in both views. No bar. Expert biomechanics approval pending.
